mnemonic: dis(去掉) + cover(盖子) → 去掉盖子→发现
en: Scientists discover new species.

zh: 青霉素的发现拯救了许多生命。

en: Racial discrimination is against the law.

zh: 我们就那部电影进行了热烈的讨论。

mnemonic: dis（不）+ease（舒适）→ 身体不舒适 → 疾病

zh: 经常锻炼可以预防疾病。

mnemonic: disease（疾病）+d（的）→ 患病的

mnemonic: dis（去掉）+enchant（使着迷）+ed → 不再着迷 → 感到幻灭
en: He became disenchanted with politics.

mnemonic: dis（失去）+grace（优雅）+ed → 失去优雅 → 丢脸

zh: 那位蒙羞的官员辞职了。

mnemonic: disgrace（丢脸）+ful（充满）→ 充满丢脸的 → 可耻的
en: That behavior is disgraceful.

mnemonic: dis（不）+grunt（咕哝）+led → 不满地咕哝着 → 满腹牢骚的
en: The disgruntled employee complained loudly.
zh: 那位不满的员工大声抱怨。

mnemonic: dis（不同）+guise（外表）→ 改变外表 → 伪装
en: She wore a hat as a disguise.
zh: 她戴了顶帽子作为伪装。

mnemonic: dis（不）+gust（味道）→ 味道不好 → 厌恶
en: The smell filled me with disgust.

mnemonic: dis（不）+honest（诚实）→ 不诚实
en: It's wrong to be dishonest.

mnemonic: dishonest（不诚实）+ly（副词）→ 不诚实地
en: He obtained the money dishonestly.
zh: 他通过不诚实手段获得了那笔钱。

mnemonic: dishonest（不诚实）+y（名词）→ 不诚实的行为
en: Dishonesty destroys trust.

mnemonic: dis（不）+honour（荣誉）→ 不荣誉 → 耻辱
en: He brought dishonour to his family.

mnemonic: dish（盘子）+washer（清洗者）→ 洗碗的机器或人
en: I loaded the dishwasher after dinner.
zh: 晚饭后我把碗放进洗碗机。

mnemonic: 像“碟子”的圆形 → 磁盘、圆盘
en: Save the file on your computer disk.
zh: 把文件保存到你的电脑磁盘上。

mnemonic: dis（不）+like（喜欢）→ 不喜欢
en: I dislike getting up early.

mnemonic: dis（分开）+miss（送走）→ 送走 → 解散、开除
en: The teacher dismissed the class early.

mnemonic: dismiss（打发）+ive（形容词）→ 一副打发人的样子 → 轻视的
en: She gave a dismissive wave of her hand.

mnemonic: dis（不）+order（秩序）→ 没有秩序 → 混乱
en: The room was in complete disorder.

mnemonic: dis(否定)+organized(有序)→没条理，像个乱糟糟的鸡窝→紊乱
en: His desk is disorganized and messy.

mnemonic: dis(分离)+perse(散开)→人群像被风吹散的蒲公英→分散
en: The crowd dispersed after the concert.
zh: 音乐会结束后人群散开了。

mnemonic: dis(分开)+play(玩)→把东西摆出来玩→陈列、显示
en: The museum displays ancient artifacts.
zh: 博物馆陈列着古代文物。

mnemonic: dis(不)+please(使高兴)→不高兴→使生气
en: Your behavior will displease your parents.
zh: 你的行为会让你父母不高兴。

mnemonic: displease的名词形式，不愉快情绪→不满
en: He showed his displeasure by frowning.

mnemonic: dis(分开)+pos(放)+al→把东西放掉→处理、丢掉
en: Waste disposal is a big problem.

mnemonic: dis(分开)+pose(放)→分开放置→处理、布置
en: Please dispose of the trash properly.

mnemonic: dis(否定)+pute(思考)→想法不同→争论
en: They dispute the ownership of the land.

mnemonic: dis(取消)+qualify(资格)→取消资格
en: Cheating will disqualify you from the game.
zh: 作弊会让你失去比赛资格。

mnemonic: dis(不)+quiet(安静)→内心不安静→焦虑不安
en: The news caused great disquiet.
zh: 这消息引起了极大的不安。

mnemonic: dis(不)+satisfied(满意的)→不满的
en: She is dissatisfied with her job.

mnemonic: dis(不)+satisfy(使满意)→使不满
en: Poor service will dissatisfy customers.
zh: 差劲的服务会让顾客不满。

mnemonic: dis(分离)+solve(解决)→把固体分开融入液体→溶解，解散
en: Salt dissolves easily in water.

mnemonic: di(二)+stan(站)+ce→两个站点之间的长度→距离
en: The distance from here to school is 2km.
zh: 从这里到学校的距离是两公里。

mnemonic: distance的形容词→距离远的→遥远的
en: He lives in a distant country.
zh: 他住在一个遥远的国家。

mnemonic: dis(不)+taste(味道)→味道不好→讨厌
en: She has a distaste for spicy food.

mnemonic: distill(蒸馏)+ery(场所)→蒸馏酒精的工厂→酿酒厂
en: The distillery produces fine whiskey.
zh: 这家酿酒厂生产优质威士忌。

mnemonic: dis(分开)+stinct(刺)→刺出来，与别的分开→明显的，不同的
en: There is a distinct difference between them.
zh: 它们之间有明显的区别。

mnemonic: distinct的名词→区别、卓越
en: He won a distinction for his work.
zh: 他因工作出色而获得荣誉。

mnemonic: distinct的动词形式→区分、辨别
en: Can you distinguish the two colors?
zh: 你能区分这两种颜色吗？

mnemonic: dis(不)+stress(压力)→压力过大→苦恼、痛苦
en: The flood caused great distress.

mnemonic: dis(分开)+tribute(给与)→分给每个人→分配、分发
en: Please distribute the books to students.

mnemonic: distribute的过去分词→被分配的、分布式的
en: The tasks are distributed equally.

mnemonic: distribute的名词→分配、分布
en: The distribution of wealth is uneven.

mnemonic: distribute+or(人)→分发者、经销商
en: He works as a car distributor.

mnemonic: di(二)+strict(严格)→严格划分的区块→区域

mnemonic: district(地区)+attorney(律师)→地区检察官

zh: 地方检察官提起了诉讼。

mnemonic: dis(不)+trust(信任)→不信任
en: She distrusts strangers easily.
zh: 她很容易不信任陌生人。

mnemonic: dis(不)+turb(搅动)→搅乱平静→打扰、使不安
en: Please do not disturb me.

mnemonic: disturb的过去分词→被打扰的、混乱的
en: He felt disturbed by the noise.

mnemonic: dis(不)+used(用) → 不再用了 → 废弃的
en: The old factory is now disused.
zh: 这座旧工厂现在已废弃。

mnemonic: di(地)+tch(土沟) → 地上挖条沟 → 沟渠；动词：抛弃(像丢进沟里)
en: He dug a ditch around the garden.
zh: 他在花园周围挖了一条沟。

mnemonic: di(抖)+ther(热) → 热得发抖 → 发抖；也指犹豫不决(像发抖一样)
en: Stop dithering and make a decision!

mnemonic: di(利尿)+uretic(尿的) → 利尿剂，让人多尿
en: Coffee is a natural diuretic.
zh: 咖啡是一种天然的利尿剂。

mnemonic: d(大)+ive(爱抚) → 大海里爱抚，一头扎进去 → 潜水，跳水
en: She loves to dive into the sea.

mnemonic: di(不同)+verse(转) → 转向不同方向 → 多种多样的
en: The group has diverse interests.
zh: 这个小组有各种各样的兴趣。

mnemonic: di(离开)+vert(转)+ing → 把注意力转开 → 娱乐的，有趣的
en: The movie was quite diverting.

mnemonic: di(分开)+vide(看) → 分开来看 → 分割，分配
en: Divide the cake into eight pieces.

mnemonic: dive(潜水)+ing → 正在潜水或跳水
en: Diving is my favorite sport.
zh: 潜水是我最喜欢的运动。

mnemonic: divine(神)+ity(性质) → 神性，神
en: She studied divinity at university.

mnemonic: divide(分)+sion(名词) → 分开的结果 → 部门，除法
en: She works in the sales division.

mnemonic: divide(分裂)+sive(形容词) → 制造分裂的 → 区分的
en: His speech was divisive.
zh: 他的演讲是制造分裂的。

mnemonic: di(离开)+vorce(转) → 转到两边去 → 离婚
en: They decided to get a divorce.

mnemonic: Do It Yourself 首字母 → 自己动手做
en: I enjoy DIY projects at home.

en: DNA contains genetic information.

mnemonic: do(做)+ck(可靠) → 做可靠停靠 → 码头；剪短(像剪掉尾巴)
en: The ship is at the dock.

mnemonic: dock(码头)+land(土地) → 港口区域 → 港区
en: Dockland is busy during the day.

mnemonic: doctor(博士)+ate(动词后缀) → 获得博士头衔
en: She earned her doctorate in physics.
zh: 她获得了物理学博士学位。

mnemonic: doc(教)+u(你)+ment(名词) → 教你东西的文件 → 文档
en: Please sign this document.

mnemonic: dodge(躲避)+y → 老是躲躲闪闪的 → 狡猾的，不可靠的
en: That website looks dodgy.
zh: 那个网站看起来不靠谱。

mnemonic: does(做)+not(不) → 不做 → 一般现在时第三人称否定
en: He doesn't like coffee.

mnemonic: dog(狗)+fish(鱼) → 像狗一样的鱼 → 狗鲨
en: Dogfish are small sharks.

mnemonic: doll(娃娃)+y(亲昵) → 洋娃娃；也指移动摄影车(像推娃娃车)
en: She played with her dolly.

mnemonic: dome(家)+stic(形容词) → 家里的 → 家庭的，国内的
en: She is a domestic helper.

mnemonic: dom(家)+inate(动词) → 在家称王 → 支配，占优势
en: The company dominates the market.

mnemonic: dom(家)+ino(小) → 小家小牌 → 多米诺骨牌
en: We played dominoes all night.
zh: 我们整晚玩多米诺骨牌。

mnemonic: do(做) not(不) 缩写 → 不要

en: Milk was left on the doorstep every morning.
zh: 每天早上牛奶被放在门阶上。

zh: 那家伙尝试吸毒真是个笨蛋。

mnemonic: dorm联想‘door门’+‘room房间’缩写 → 宿舍就是一个门里很多房间
en: I live in a dorm with three roommates.
zh: 我和三个室友住在宿舍里。

mnemonic: dormitory = dorm + tory → 睡觉（dormire）的地方 → 宿舍（比dorm更正式）
en: The dormitory is quiet after midnight.

mnemonic: dose（剂量）+ age（年龄）→ 按年龄调整用药量 → 剂量
en: The doctor prescribed a proper dosage.

mnemonic: 谐音‘都死’→ 吃错剂量全都死 → 剂量；服药
en: Take one dose of medicine every four hours.

mnemonic: 小点像字母i上的点 → dot就是点，也可以记成‘道特’→ 道路上的小点
en: Connect the dots to draw a picture.

mnemonic: dot+ted（过去分词）→ 被点上点的 → 有点的；星罗棋布的
en: The map was dotted with small villages.
zh: 地图上星罗棋布着小村庄。

mnemonic: double双倍+cream奶油 → 双倍脂肪的浓奶油 → 高脂肪浓奶油
en: She added double cream to the cake batter.
zh: 她在蛋糕面糊中加了高脂肪浓奶油。

mnemonic: double双重+standard标准 → 对同一事用不同标准 → 双重标准（尤指性道德）
en: Many people criticize the double standard in society.
zh: 许多人批评社会上的双重标准。

mnemonic: double双重+speak说话 → 说两面话 → 欺人之谈、故弄玄虚的言词
en: Politicians often use doublespeak to confuse people.
zh: 政客们常用欺人之谈来迷惑大众。

mnemonic: double的副词形式 → 双倍地、双重地；记‘加倍里’
en: You must be doubly careful on icy roads.
zh: 在结冰的路上你必须加倍小心。

mnemonic: 谐音‘大把特’→ 心里有‘大把的特别’疑问 → 怀疑
en: I doubt that he will come on time.
zh: 我怀疑他是否能准时来。

mnemonic: doubt+ful（充满）→ 充满怀疑的 → 可疑的、疑心的
en: The outcome of the game is doubtful.

mnemonic: doubt+less（没有）→ 没有怀疑的 → 无疑地；记‘大把特累死’反义

mnemonic: 谐音‘斗’→ 揉面时要用力斗 → 生面团；也俚语指钱
en: Knead the dough until it becomes smooth.
zh: 揉面团直到它变得光滑。

mnemonic: dough面团+nut坚果 → 面团做成圆圈像坚果环 → 油炸圈饼、甜甜圈
en: She ate a chocolate doughnut for breakfast.
zh: 她早餐吃了一个巧克力甜甜圈。

mnemonic: down向下+payment付款 → 先付一部分钱‘向下’压 → 预付定金
en: We need to make a down payment on the house.
zh: 我们需要为这房子支付首付。

mnemonic: down向下+stairs楼梯 → 顺着楼梯向下 → 下楼
en: He ran down stairs to answer the door.

mnemonic: down下+under下面 → 地球下方 → 指澳大利亚、新西兰等（在地球另一边）
en: She is traveling to down under next month.
zh: 她下个月要去澳大利亚旅行。

mnemonic: down向下+fall跌落 → 向下跌落 → 衰败、大雨（像天塌下来）
en: His greed led to his downfall.

mnemonic: down向下+grade等级 → 等级向下 → 降低、贬低；下坡
en: The company decided to downgrade the job position.
zh: 公司决定降低这个职位等级。

mnemonic: down向下+hill山 → 向山下 → 下坡；比喻事情变糟
en: The road goes downhill from here.
zh: 这条路从这里开始下坡。

mnemonic: 伦敦唐宁街10号是英国首相官邸 → 唐宁街代表英国政府
en: Downing Street issued a statement this morning.
zh: 唐宁街今早发表了一份声明。

mnemonic: down向下+right正确 → ‘直直地向下’ → 十足的、彻底的、明白的
en: That is downright outrageous behavior!
zh: 那完全是令人发指的行为！

mnemonic: down向下+side边 → 下边 → 底侧；比喻缺点、下降趋势
en: The downside of this plan is high cost.
zh: 这个计划的缺点是成本高。

mnemonic: down向下+stairs楼梯 → 楼下（泛指楼下区域）
en: The bathroom is downstairs on the left.

mnemonic: down向下+stream溪流 → 顺着溪流向下 → 下游
en: Pollution flows downstream to the sea.

mnemonic: down向下+ward朝向 → 向下的方向 → 向下的
en: The plane began its downward descent.

mnemonic: 谐音'坠浮特'，东西坠入水中漂浮→漂流
en: The boat began to drift slowly.

mnemonic: 谐音'锥儿'，锥子钻孔，反复训练→钻孔机/训练
en: The soldier practiced with a drill.

mnemonic: drink+er，喝东西的人→饮者，特指酒徒
en: He is a heavy drinker of coffee.
zh: 他是个重度咖啡饮用者。

mnemonic: drinking（饮用）+ water（水）→饮用水
en: We need clean drinking water.
zh: 我们需要干净的饮用水。

mnemonic: 谐音'坠破'，水滴坠下破裂→滴下
en: The rain drip from the roof.

mnemonic: drive（开车）+ in（进入）→开车进入享受服务
en: Let's go to the drive-in movie.
zh: 我们去免下车电影院吧。

mnemonic: drive（开车）+ way（路）→车开的路→车道
en: The car is parked in the driveway.

mnemonic: driving（驾驶）+ licence（执照）→驾驶执照
en: She passed her driving licence test.
zh: 她通过了驾驶执照考试。

mnemonic: 谐音'坠坡'，从坡上坠落→落下，滴下

mnemonic: drop（掉落）+ings（复数）→掉落的东西→动物粪便
en: Bird droppings stained the car.

mnemonic: 谐音'捉奥特'，干旱时奥特曼都抓不到水→干旱
en: The drought ruined the crops.

mnemonic: drove（驾驶过去式）+s，人群像被驱动一样涌动→成群的人
en: Tourists came in droves to the beach.
zh: 游客成群结队来到海滩。

mnemonic: 谐音'抓挠'，淹死时拼命抓挠→淹死
en: He nearly drowned in the river.

mnemonic: 谐音'抓个'，抓个药或毒品→药，麻药
en: This drug can cure the disease.
zh: 这种药可以治愈这种疾病。

mnemonic: drug（药）+ store（商店）→药店，兼卖杂货
en: I need to go to the drugstore for aspirin.
zh: 我需要去药店买阿司匹林。

mnemonic: 谐音'朱伊德'，古代巫师的名字→巫师，祭师
en: The druid performed a mysterious ritual.
zh: 德鲁伊执行了一个神秘的仪式。

mnemonic: 谐音'壮'，敲鼓壮声势→鼓
en: He plays the drum in the band.

mnemonic: 谐音'撞磕'，喝醉了走路撞磕→喝醉的
en: He got drunk at the party.

mnemonic: drunk+en，形容酒醉的状态→酒醉的
en: A drunken man was lying on the road.

mnemonic: dry（干燥）+er（物）→使干燥的东西→干衣机
en: Put the clothes in the dryer.

mnemonic: duke（公爵）+ess（女性）→公爵夫人
en: The duchess wore a beautiful dress.
zh: 公爵夫人穿着漂亮的裙子。

mnemonic: duke（公爵）+y（领地）→公爵领地，公国
en: The duke ruled his duchy wisely.
zh: 公爵明智地统治着他的公国。

en: The payment is due tomorrow.

mnemonic: 谐音'叨'，钝刀叨个不停→迟钝的，无趣的

en: Don't dump rubbish here.

mnemonic: 大粪 → 动物排泄物，谐音‘当’ → 当肥料用
en: The farmer used dung as fertilizer.
